description: An item pattern comparison in optional flat braces tests every item beside an active structural comparison.
grammar:
%rule text $x:word $y:word [{$c:chain-inner "r"}] chain-inner
%conditions $x ≅ $y ∧ $c ≇ #(⋱ chain-inner« bi-free chain »)
%rule chain-inner bi-free chain | step
%rule bi-free "b"
%rule chain step
%rule step "a"
%rule word "a"
